claim: Debug.Assert(rowIdForOrdinal != null) asserts a false invariant reached by legitimate, previously-supported paths (no rowid found), so Debug builds of the existing test suite trip it.
raw: The rewritten assert (`rowIdForOrdinal != null`) asserts a condition that is *false* in fully supported scenarios: no other column of the blob's table in the result set, expression columns, composite-PK tables — the very cases the `MemoryStream` fallback on line 396–399 exists to serve.

claim: Negative caching was lost: when no rowid is found, the full metadata scan (including pragma_table_info query) reruns on every GetStream/GetBytes/GetChars call — a performance regression vs the old _rowidOrdinal = -1 sentinel.
raw: The old code cached the "not found" outcome (`_rowidOrdinal = -1`), so the scan ran at most once per record. The new code only populates `RowIds` on success; when the scan fails (composite PK, expression, lone blob column), nothing is cached and the entire loop reruns on every call

claim: String cache key $"{blobDatabaseName}_{blobTableName}" is ambiguous — underscore-containing names can collide and silently reuse the wrong table's rowid ordinal, resurrecting the original bug.
raw: `("main_foo", "bar")` and `("main", "foo_bar")` both produce key `"main_foo_bar"`. Database aliases (via `ATTACH`) and table names routinely contain underscores.

claim: No test covers the mixed join case (one table streams, the other falls back), no reverse-order read, and the new test never asserts stream types (IsType<SqliteBlob>/MemoryStream).
raw: There is no test joining a rowid table with a composite-PK (or otherwise rowid-less) table, and no test reading the blobs in reverse order (B then A).

claim: RowIdInfo.TableName is written but never read; the nested class is unnecessary and could be replaced by a Dictionary<(string,string),int>; if kept, properties should be get-only.
raw: `TableName` is written but never read anywhere; only `Ordinal` is consumed (line 402). A `Dictionary<(string, string), int>` (or `int?` for negative caching per issue 2) replaces the whole nested class. If kept, the properties should be get-only

claim: RowIds field lacks the private modifier and uses PascalCase; repo .editorconfig requires private _camelCase fields (should be private readonly ... _rowIds).
raw: `readonly Dictionary<string, RowIdInfo> RowIds` lacks the `private` modifier and uses PascalCase; every sibling field is `private` `_camelCase`, and the repo `.editorconfig` (lines 193–195) defines the `_camelCase`-with-underscore-prefix style for private fields.

claim: Stray blank line added inside the namespace.
raw: `SqliteDataRecord.cs:17` — stray blank line added inside the namespace.

claim: Local `string rowidkey` should be `var rowIdKey` (repo uses var; compound-word casing).
raw: `SqliteDataRecord.cs:328` — `string rowidkey` → `var rowIdKey` (repo uses `var`; compound-word casing).

claim: `rowIdForOrdinal!=null` is missing spaces around the != operator.
raw: `SqliteDataRecord.cs:393` — `rowIdForOrdinal!=null` missing spaces around `!=`.

claim: `RowIdInfo? rowIdForOrdinal = null;` is redundant; TryGetValue(..., out var rowIdForOrdinal) assigns it.
raw: `SqliteDataRecord.cs:327` — `RowIdInfo? rowIdForOrdinal = null;` is redundant; `TryGetValue(..., out var rowIdForOrdinal)` assigns it.

claim: The blank line after `var pkColumns = -1L;` was dropped — pointless formatting churn in the diff.
raw: Line 331: the blank line after `var pkColumns = -1L;` was dropped — pointless formatting churn in the diff.

claim: Console.WriteLine in the test (only console write in the suite) should be replaced with assertions on the read values.
raw: `SqliteDataReaderTest.cs:171` — `Console.WriteLine(...)` is the only console write in the entire sqlite test suite; it should be assertions (`Assert.Equal(1, reader.GetInt32(0)); Assert.Equal(1000, reader.GetInt32(2));`), which would also strengthen the test.

claim: Test comments narrate change history ("this was failing. now should be fixed"), one is inaccurate ("get len of abuff" — it reads bytes, not length), plus grammar issue on line 168.
raw: comment "`//this was failing. now should be fixed`" narrates change history; the test name and issue reference in the commit carry that context. Same for "`//get len of abuff`" (inaccurate — it reads bytes, not length) and the grammar in line 168.

claim: The verbatim SQL string has trailing whitespace and an indentation style unlike neighboring tests; single-line SQL would match the file.
raw: Lines 152–181: the verbatim SQL string has trailing whitespace and an indentation style unlike neighboring tests; single-line SQL as in `GetBytes_works_streaming` would match the file.

claim: Consider a self-join test (A a JOIN A b) to document that same-table aliases share one cache entry by design.
raw: Consider a self-join test (`A a JOIN A b`) to document that same-table aliases share one cache entry by design (sqlite3 metadata reports the origin table for both aliases).
